facts.fact: 仆人确认：仪式与交配全程有观众
facts.anchor: “All of it.” the servant said with a smile

facts.fact: 阳台石沿邀请：今晚你不会死
facts.anchor: He smirked. “You’re not dying tonight. Now sit. I won’t let you fall.”

facts.fact: 阳台亲密后他 bored 收场走人
facts.anchor: There. Easy enough,” Winter said, his tone bored

facts.fact: 怒砸木块：我不是你的妓女
facts.anchor: “I’m not one of your harlots. What are you going to do tomorrow night?

facts.fact: 争吵：我嘴上假装无事、心里全是你
facts.anchor: Even though that’s all I will fucking think about. You. As I have been.

facts.fact: 争吵升级：你若第一场就死了就没这么复杂——怪你
facts.anchor: If you had just died in the first game, things wouldn’t have been so complicated. This is your fault.

facts.fact: 她回击：因为是你救了我——还是两次
facts.anchor: Because you saved me, you fool!” she seethed, shoving his chest. “Twice, I might add.

facts.fact: 他的崩溃之问：你为什么偏偏不是狼
facts.anchor: Why couldn’t you have just been a fucking wolf?

facts.fact: 她的反问：你为什么不能做个不那般残忍的人类
facts.anchor: “And why couldn’t you be a human who isn’t half cruel.”

facts.fact: 结尾：你有一半是你母亲——还不全然邪恶
facts.anchor: “You’re half your mother too. Not entirely wicked.”
